notes: Sheet is north-up (roughly). Broadway runs page-vertical at the left edge with only its east side drawn. Reading Road (~65-75 ft, no width printed; north side is the sheet-148/154 outline, y 1607 at Broadway) runs E-W from Broadway to Spring, then ENE past Pendleton to the right edge; Spring/Reading point is also its angle point. Spring Street: ~40 ft north of Reading Road (148 outline), printed SPRING 12' south of it, running between the Eagle Picher Lead Co. buildings and the corroding house down to East Court, where it is ~24 ft ('24'' printed between the shed at x 1018 and the Mocres-Coney block at x 1097). Pendleton St (60 ft, 148/154 outlines, x 1790-1993) ends at Reading Road from the north. 'EAGLE PICHER LEAD COMPANY' printed diagonally at y~2050-2150 is a company name over a yard, not a street. East Court Street: 70' printed at Broadway (block lines 3330/3575), 66' further east; passes Spring, crosses Reedy (REEDY ST., ~58 ft, slanting) under the curving railroad, passes Lock (printed LUCK ST., ~34 ft, sheet-142 outline) and meets Gilbert Av's SW end at the bottom right. Eggleston Av is indicated only by a short sheet-141 outline corner at (427,3650)-(457,3690) on Broadway's east side; Broadway/Eggleston is not recorded. The right half is the C.L.&N. / Pennsylvania rail yard and freight house (sheet 150 area): no streets. Points are within ~15 px except Gilbert/East Court (+/-25 px, Gilbert's east half off the paper).
